assumptions.Name: modality
assumptions.Scope: text_decoder_of_multimodal: the graph prices the text decoder of a multimodal model: its vision or audio tower, and the encoder work a multimodal request adds, are not priced

assumptions.Name: compute_rate_fp32
assumptions.Scope: bf16: FP32 weights run at the TF32 tensor-core rate, taken as half the dense BF16 peak as NVIDIA's datasheets state it for every catalog part; the catalog states no TF32 peak, and the ramp is BF16's

assumptions.Name: cudagraph_mode
assumptions.Scope: FULL_AND_PIECEWISE: vLLM v0.31.0's default (vllm/config/compilation.py:614); the engine downgrades it where an attention backend does not support full graphs, which the kernel cannot see

assumptions.Name: max_cudagraph_capture_size
assumptions.Scope: 512: vLLM v0.31.0's default, min(max_num_seqs x decode_query_len x 2, 512) (VllmConfig._set_cudagraph_sizes, vllm/config/vllm.py:2442-2460), as the deployment states neither max_cudagraph_capture_size nor cudagraph_capture_sizes; a step above it runs with no graph

assumptions.Name: routing_imbalance
assumptions.Scope: 1 (evenly loaded): no default-role routing profile for muse-spark-open-816b-a42b-nvfp4//decode/linear/ep8: every expert-parallel rank is priced at the mean rank's routed tokens and experts

assumptions.Name: engine_version
assumptions.Scope: 0.31.0: the scenario declares vLLM 0.32.0 and its rules pack is that release's, but the engine behaviour this kernel encodes -- backend selection, defaults, refusals -- is v0.31.0's (README, Sources of truth)

substitutions.reason: muse-spark-open-816b-a42b-nvfp4 is a multimodal checkpoint, so vLLM keeps its vision tower and projector resident and profiles the encoder, which the catalog graph does not price (it holds the text decoder only); the weights, KV blocks and step time are those of language_model_only: true
